title: Tip Calculator: how it works, formula and examples
excerpt: Tip Calculator: Calculate a tip and split the bill. Learn how to use it, the formula behind it, a worked example and answers to common questions.
content:
The [Tip Calculator](/tip-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Calculate a tip and split the bill. Enter your bill amount, tip and number of people and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

A tip calculator works out gratuity on a bill and splits the total evenly — no mental math at the table. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers. Related Finance tools include [Loan Calculator](/loan-calculator), [Mortgage Calculator](/mortgage-calculator) and [Car Loan Calculator](/car-loan-calculator). People also look for this tool as "gratuity calculator", "bill split calculator", "restaurant tip calculator".

## How to use the Tip Calculator

Start by entering your bill amount, then entering your tip (%) and finally entering your number of people. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults.

1. Enter your bill amount.
2. Enter your tip (%).
3. Enter your number of people.
4. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
5. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Tip = Bill × tip% ÷ 100. Per person = (Bill + Tip) ÷ people.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Tip Calculator](/tip-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. An 18% tip on 84 is 15.12; split three ways, each person pays 33.04. Try the same figures in the [Tip Calculator](/tip-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Bill amount: 84, Tip: 18 %, Number of people: 3), the [Tip Calculator](/tip-calculator) returns Each person pays: 33.04, Tip: 15.12, Total: 99.12. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Loan Calculator](/loan-calculator) is worth a look before you finish.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- 10%: move the decimal one place left. 20%: double it.
- In the US 15–20% is customary at sit-down restaurants.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### Should I tip on tax?

Etiquette guides often suggest tipping on the pre-tax amount; either is acceptable. Try it with your own numbers in the [Tip Calculator](/tip-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### How much to tip for delivery?

Around 10–20%, with a minimum of a few dollars for small orders. Try it with your own numbers in the [Tip Calculator](/tip-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What formula does the Tip Calculator use?

Tip = Bill × tip% ÷ 100. Per person = (Bill + Tip) ÷ people. You can see it in action in the [Tip Calculator](/tip-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the Tip Calculator?

Just Bill amount, Tip and Number of people. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.
